_about: NFTT posts written from earlier pieces of the author's own: the platform and the date each original first appeared. Every NFTT post is a new essay, so this records the ORIGINALS, never a claim that the post itself first ran elsewhere. Dates are only those the post's own text states (a date the source marks undated stays out). The platform comes from the post's text, or, where the post does not name it, from the publishing record plus the author's confirmation, and the evidence field says which. Rendered into the byline by scripts/nftt_published.py stamp; checked by --check.
